findings: Known hit counts support P(at least one of a specific itemID)=hitCasts/completedCasts within that source cohort.
A fixed positive stack of1 makes per-rank E equal to P within that cohort. This is not a universal max-stack rule for other specializations or studies.
Dust histograms give both hit probability and average quantity, with reconstructed totals explicitly distinguished from direct player totals.
Courtly Wrists1000 max-spec means are directly verified; its probabilities and positive ranges remain unknown.

Exact-item Looter reference cohorts have unverified rarity/ilvl/skill/spec/date mixtures. Retain as provisional exact-item references, not a universal uncommon/rare/epic constant or zero-skill baseline.
Unlisted outcomes remain unknown; neither missing material rows nor gaps in total hit counts prove zero-output casts.

fieldSemantics.pAtLeastOne: Probability a completed disenchant yields at least one unit of this exact output itemID/rank; source hit count divided by its shared cohort denominator.
fieldSemantics.EUnitsPerCompletedCast: Total units of this exact output divided by all completed disenchants, including casts without that output.
fieldSemantics.EUnitsWhenReceived: Total units divided by hit casts; conditional quantity, distinct from unconditional mean.
fieldSemantics.positiveMinObserved: Smallest positive stack in source; zero/non-hit casts are excluded. Not a guaranteed future lower bound.
fieldSemantics.R2ShareOfShardUnits: R2 units divided by pooled shard units; never substitute for per-cast hit probability.
fieldSemantics.probabilityUnion: Unknown without joint outcome/exclusivity evidence; do not simply add ranks or material probabilities.

pipelineAdvice.reason: Owner requests sourced probability and yields in tooltip, including weak provisional references. Unknown conditions lower confidence and require explicit reference labels; they do not erase measured source fields.
pipelineAdvice.variantWarning: Courtly Wrists239671 has upgradeable crafted variants, including epic with crests. Do not apply Rare shard reference to every variant solely by itemID.
